summary: Klamath National Forest peak where a 1932 diary entry mentions an emergency lookout point; no source describes a lookout there today.

facts.status_note: Not on a July 2026 list of standing Oregon lookouts, and that list warns its information may be out of date.

visit.trail_note: PeakVisor says a trail leads to the summit of the peak. It does not mention a lookout.

events.note: June 5, 1932 Fox Diaries entry, quoted by the Forest Lookouts page: outpost wire strung to Doe Peak, which the entry calls an emergency lookout point. No construction date is given.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: the Forest Lookouts page (agency and a single 1932 diary quote, Fox Diaries not checked directly), a PeakVisor listing (county, peak height, trail), and the July 2026 standing list. The PeakVisor figures describe the peak, not a lookout structure. The page gives a survey-style code, 41S-1W-12, which was not interpreted. listsofjohn.com returned HTTP 403 and was not used. No NHLR or FFLOS Oregon entry under this name appears in the local crawl cache. Whether any lookout structure remains on the summit was not established.
